QuestInfo.name: We've Got a Flat!
QuestInfo.0: A police officer of Yu Garden, #p9310533#, has a problem. Go find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: #p9310533# is stuck because Yu Garden's only motorcycle has a flat tire. It's up to you to fix it before anyone needs him.\r\nBut you need a tire... Where can you get a tire?\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You fixed the motorcycle! You have a feeling you'll be seeing a lot of #p9310533#...

default.0: Hey, where'd you go? You said you'd be back in a minute. But now it's too late.

item.0: Weren't you going to bring me some tires? Where are the tires?
